text:
sam_fin: Heads up  EmbedlyTek returned their commercial terms for our pilot. A few billing and invoicing items look risky for finance. Can procurement + ops quickly sanity-check?

olivia_procure: Paste the specific bits you saw.

sam_fin: Key snippets: 1) Minimum annual commitment enforced if pilot runs >30 days, 2) monthly invoices but require EDI PO matching with our PO# on remittance or penalty, 3) credits for SLA are issued as "service credits" with 90-day validity only, 4) invoice disputes must be raised within 15 days or locked.

rita_ml: Minimum annual commitment after a short pilot? That seems aggressive. Why would they auto-convert a pilot to an annual commit? We need a hard pilot carveout.

ben_ops: Also, EDI PO matching is annoying — finance needs the ability to pay via ACH and receive a normal invoice PDF. If they force EDI matching, our AP pipeline needs mapping. Any chance they accept PO-number on invoice instead?

alan_legal: Contract ask: remove auto-enrollment into annual commitment. At minimum: pilot must be explicitly converted with signed SOW. Add a clause: pilot PO does not trigger minimum commitment. Also extend dispute window to 60 days and make SLA credits refundable (applied to invoices or refunded).

vendor_pm: Quick clarifications from EmbedlyTek: the minimum commit clause is to prevent churn after provisioning. We can make the pilot explicit if you sign a "non-committal pilot" addendum. EDI is our preferred invoicing for enterprise but we can provide PDFs. SLA credits are currently service credits only.

sam_fin: PDFs ok but the EDI-only path can't be a blocker. Finance: we need the invoice to show line-item mapping by account code (e.g., SKU, team-code) for automated reconciliation.

olivia_procure: Also confirm whether they support invoice-to-cost-center mapping for multiple product teams. We're onboarding search + recommendations and want separate billing tags.

ben_ops: Technical billing concern: we need the metering definition for "vector-hours" vs "inference-requests". If they bill vector-hours we must know if reused vectors (cache hits) or multi-tenant deduping count.

rita_ml: Agreed. Also ask for a sample billing export for a typical day: include fields (timestamp, sku, vector_count, vector_hours, request_count, team_tag). We will reconcile against our telemetry.

alan_legal: Add a clause: annual true-up must be performed with 90 days' notice and credits applied on next invoice. No unilateral price changes that materially (>7%) increase rates within first 12 months.

vendor_pm: We can provide a CSV usage export and a sample invoice. We do dedupe by stable vector hash; cache hits to customer-managed KV are not billed. We'll send the hashing spec. Regarding pilot, we can sign a non-committal pilot addendum; onboarding fee refundable if commit signed.

sam_fin: On refunds/credits  credits must be line-item on invoice and auto-applied; service-credit vouchers are not acceptable to finance.

olivia_procure: Procurement ask list to send to EmbedlyTek: 1) explicit non-committal pilot addendum draft, 2) sample invoice PDF & CSV usage export schema, 3) EDI as optional with PDF primary, 4) extended dispute window to 60 days, 5) refundable SLA credits or invoice-applied credits, 6) no auto-convert to annual without signed SOW.

ben_ops: Plus: technical ask for usage semantics: define "vector-hour" precisely (include hashing algorithm, whether near-duplicates deduped, and how batches are counted). Ask for example cost calc for a 100k request batch with 8-dim vectors and 10% cache hit.

rita_ml: I'll draft the technical questions and a sample reconciler export from our side to send them.

alan_legal: I'll draft the contract language for the pilot carveout, dispute window, and credit application. Olivia, include me on the procurement email.

procurement_bot: Reminder: attach the vendor quote, sample invoices, and pilot addendum to the procurement packet (Confluence: vendor-evals/EmbedlyTek). Decision milestone: 2025-01-15.

olivia_procure: Thanks  I'll compile the list and send the vendor an email today. If they insist on EDI-only invoicing, we'll require a 1-year FX/format guarantee and a tech integration plan with AP.

sam_fin: One more finance note: require an account-level SKU breakdown per invoice so we can map charges to GL codes automatically. Without it AP will have to manual-match which defeats the point.

vendor_pm: Understood. We'll include sample GL mappings and a short spec for the EDI/CSV exports. Sending initial artifacts by EOD.

olivia_procure: Perfect. Team: once we have their artifacts we'll reconvene for a final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
